title: Report on P.H. KOETRLOCK and Individual Named CHARLES
title_ja: P.H.コエトロックとチャールズという個人に関する報告
summary: This document details information regarding P.H. KOETRLOCK's interactions with an individual named CHARLES who expressed concerning opinions about President Kennedy. It also covers KOETRLOCK's other activities and contacts.
